messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: RidgeView (customer: ridgeview-pro) - eu-west-1 - p99 latency spike detected. p99=1.42s (SLO=0.9s). auto-page sent to on-call. :rotating_light:
andy-oncall: on it. joining channel now. can someone paste the graphs and which pool this is hitting?
maria-sre: looks like requests are hitting dedicated pool `ridgeview-euwest-pool-2`. 95th still okay, p99 up across seq lengths 128-512. CPU/GPU usage normal, but queue depth spiked.
andy-oncall: queue depth + backlog matches a traffic flurry from tenant tag `tenant=ridgeview-pro`. suspect tenant noise. starting tenant-level throttle.
devin-rte: applying soft throttle now: `rwctl rate-limit --tenant ridgeview-pro --qps 30` — will monitor p99.
ops-bot: throttle command accepted (run_id=9c12f).
leah-pm: pinging RidgeView AM, prepping customer comms. Can we estimate impact (error rate / successful latency)?
maria-sre: errors unchanged; most requests succeed but slow. routing policy shows 72% to dedicated pool, 28% fallback variants.
andy-oncall: rolling prefix cache clear on pool to remove bad KV cache entries: ```
kubectl -n inference exec pool-ridgeview-2 -- /bin/sh -c "rm -f /kv_cache/prefix_* && kill -HUP 1"
```
ops-bot: cache clear completed on 3/3 nodes (task=cache-evict-1712056812).
devin-rte: p99 improved to 1.05s after throttle + cache eviction. still above SLO. considering tenant isolation (move to isolated pool).
andy-oncall: spinning up warm-isolate pool: `provisioner create-pool --name ridgeview-isolate-eu1 --gpus=2 --warm=true` — ETA ~6m.
ridgeview-support: we see increased latency from 09:12 UTC. customers reporting timeouts on long prompts. Are you able to reduce tail? they need ETA for mitigation.
leah-pm: telling customer ETA ~15min for a mitigation plan. will offer optional failover to hosted model for critical traffic.
maria-sre: while isolate pool spins up, enabling model variant fallback for large seqs: `route override --tenant ridgeview-pro --model-variant sm-quant --seq-max 512` (nonblocking).
andy-oncall: fallback enabled. p99 down to 0.78s for seq<=512, but >512 still 1.2s.
devin-rte: isolate pool ready. doing controlled migration: move 30% traffic first, health-checking. `traffic-shift --from pool-ridgeview-2 --to ridgeview-isolate-eu1 --percent 30 --checks 10s`
ops-bot: traffic-shift job queued (job=ts-1712056951).
andy-oncall: initial 30% healthy. moving to 70%.
ops-bot: traffic-shift 70% -> healthy. final shift to 100% starting.
andy-oncall: migration complete. all traffic on isolate pool. p99 steady at 0.62s. good.
leah-pm: customer notified: mitigation applied, isolated pool in place, monitoring ongoing. CC'ing AM for follow-up.
ridgeview-support: thanks — visible improvements on our side. we'll keep monitoring and report if any regressions.
maria-sre: action items: 1) run replay on sample logs to validate no bad prompt patterns; 2) tune autoscale thresholds for tenant; 3) post-incident follow-up with ridgeview on traffic shaping.
devin-rte: capturing metrics and trace IDs for postmortem. saving snapshot: `s3://rw-incident-dumps/ridgeview/1712056789/`
andy-oncall: marking incident as mitigated. creating handoff to ops for next 2 hours watch.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: ridgeview-pro eu-west-1 p99 breach resolved. Severity: Sev2. Postmortem and customer RCA required. /incident create ridgeview-eu-p99-20260317
leah-pm: will schedule postmortem with customer and include remediation (autoscale, throttling presets, routing guardrails).
ops-bot: on-call handoff posted to #eng-oncall (page sequence 2 -> oncall-next).
andy-oncall: thanks team. logging notes and will attach graphs + commands used to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
